I reviewed my initial assessment against the Self-Reflection Checklist.

The taxonomy mismatches for dogs (not being German Shepherds) and flowers (not being daisies) are expected given the stylized nature of the prompt ('checkered dogs', 'sparkling flowers'). These are creative interpretations, not defects, so I did not reduce authenticity for them. Only the actual structural artifacts (fusion, melting) impacted the authenticity score.
